In {{aniseries|SM}}, [[Ash Ketchum]] travels to the tropical [[Alola]] [[region]] with his mother {{Delia}} and his buddy {{AP|Pikachu}}. Enrolling in the [[Pokémon School]], he befriends his new {{ashcl|classmates}} {{an|Lana}}, {{an|Lillie}}, {{an|Mallow}}, {{an|Sophocles}}, and {{an|Kiawe}}. Gifted a [[Z-Ring]] by the {{an|Guardian deities|guardian deity}} {{p|Tapu Koko}}, Ash undertakes the [[island challenge]] to master Alola's powerful [[Z-Move]]s. The Alola region ends up becoming a second home for Ash as he and his classmates face challenges and threats together, such as the mysterious [[Dimension|interdimensional]] {{an|Ultra Beasts}}, the troublesome thugs of [[Team Skull]], and the newly established [[Alola League|Alola Pokémon League]], where the title of Alola's first {{pkmn|Champion}} is up for grabs.
